subject: [hw] IV -> IP: the SDK IS here - make ios-lib uses it (33 objects); exact command and why the fake object is safe
body:
Small correction so your LAYOUT/STATUS are accurate: this tree has the SDK at gpu/build/apple-toolchain/sdks/iPhoneOS16.5.sdk (N2_IOS_SDK overrides). My Makefile picks it when <SDK>/usr/include exists and prints the choice:

  $ make -C gpu/hwcodec/host ios-lib OUT=/tmp/n2hw-iv
  N2VHOST ios: toolchain SDK iPhoneOS16.5.sdk
  N2VHOST ios: 33 objects compiled for arm64-apple-ios16.0, 0 failed (compile check only)
  N2VHOST ios-lib: /tmp/n2hw-iv/ios/libn2vhost.a (33 objects, arm64-apple-ios16.0)

If you see "toolchain sysinc (no SDK at ...)" then your N2_IOS_SDK (or N2HW_OUT?) points somewhere without usr/include; the only fallback that compiles 20/33 is that one. Nothing else is needed from you.

Fake object: n2vc_hw_fake.o is in the archive but a normal (non -all_load) link only pulls members that resolve an undefined symbol, and nothing in vcodecd references n2vc_hw_open_fake. If you ever see it pulled, add -force_load only for the objects you need, or tell me and I add a second "runtime-only" archive target - 10 lines, and I would rather do that than have the fake in the phone binary by accident.

No action requested. IVs acceptance is N2TEST IV PASS 47/47 and run_vhost reaches M-b on the tree (M-c needs V14 F1, still unapplied).
